body.name: \((I_{\pi}:\pi\in\Pi_m)\)
body.construction: If \(N<b_{\beta,D}\log(40m)\), set \(I_{\pi}=G_{\tau}\) for every \(\pi\). Otherwise use \(T^{\mathrm{ci}}_{n,m}=\{N/\log(40m)\}^{1/(2\beta+4)}\). At \(z=T^{\mathrm{ci}}_{n,m},eT^{\mathrm{ci}}_{n,m}\), form \(J_{xa}(z)=[0,1]\cap2m\operatorname{CP}_{\gamma_0/(4m)}\{K_{xa}(z);n\}\). Intersect the two induced Hall strips with \([1,4]\times[-\log2,0]\) to obtain \(\Theta_{xa}\), replacing an empty region by that full rectangle. For each \(\pi\), minimize and maximize the unique core root over \(\prod_x\Theta_{x,\pi(x)}\), obtaining \(\underline t_{\pi}\) and \(\overline t_{\pi}\), and set \(I_{\pi}=[\underline t_{\pi}-\varepsilon_{\tau},\overline t_{\pi}+\varepsilon_{\tau}]\cap G_{\tau}\). Compact polygon optimization and monotone scalar bisection make every endpoint computable; any numerical inconsistency returns \(G_{\tau}\).
